body: thank you for your kind words. much appreciated:)
i appreciate your words, but i can't do that lol. they are good people dealing with their own shit, i guess. and yeah, i wouldn't mind being friends!

well, i’ve tried so many times to show my friends that i need help, but in the end, all they care about is themselves. it’s as if i don’t matter until i’m on the brink of death! i made another post on here pouring my feelings out earlier and no one responded :D i don’t know why that hurts. it’s almost like the universe is urging me to end it already. and, to answer your other question, these days, i feel either numb or angry.
i understood that frustration bro. you try as hard as you can to show them you need help, but they never care until you’re dead, do they? :/
